How to Enter
Entering Vista Pointe
  1. Your door access code will be sent via Airbnb message on the day of check-in.
  2. Locate the digital keypad at the front door.
  3. Enter your code — the lock will beep and unlock when accepted.
  4. Contact the host immediately if you have any trouble.
Front entrance — Vista Pointe
Section
Parking
Parking at Vista Pointe
  • Free off-street parking available in the driveway — fits multiple vehicles.
  • Please park fully on the property — do not block the street or sidewalk.
  • Additional street parking available on Vista Pointe and surrounding streets.

House Rules
General Rules
  • Max occupancy: 16 guests.
  • No smoking anywhere on the property, indoors or outdoors.
  • Pets welcome — clean up after your pet, keep off furniture.
  • No parties without host approval.
  • Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM.
Pool & Jacuzzi Rules
  • Jacuzzi: Controlled remotely — request activation at least 30 minutes in advance.
  • Pool heating: Available on request — $100/day fee. Takes 8–10 hours in winter.
  • No glass near the pool or jacuzzi.
  • Shower before entering.
  • Children must be supervised by an adult at all times.
  • No diving.
Pool area
Transient Occupancy Tax (TOT)

This property is in Bonita, CA (County of San Diego). An 8% TOT applies to stays under 30 days. This is collected through Airbnb and is included in your booking total.

Check-Out
Before You Go
  1. Strip all beds — leave used linens on the floor.
  2. Wash all dishes and return to cabinets.
  3. Take all trash to the bins outside.
  4. Empty the refrigerator of perishables.
  5. Turn off all lights, fans, electronics.
  6. Ensure fire pit is fully extinguished.
  7. Close the BBQ lid.
  8. Lock all doors and windows.
  9. Message the host to confirm check-out.

Check-out time: 11:00 AM.
